description: This file contains bash functions for network interface status retrieval and management, including IP address, subnet, gateway, DNS, and device control functions, utilizing ubus and jsonfilter commands.

methods.name: __network_ifstatus
methods.description: Core function to retrieve network interface status information using ubus and jsonfilter.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddr
methods.description: Retrieve the first IPv4 address of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddr6
methods.description: Retrieve the first IPv6 address or prefix of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_subnet
methods.description: Retrieve the IPv4 subnet of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_subnet6
methods.description: Retrieve the IPv6 subnet of a specified interface, excluding link-local addresses.

methods.name: network_get_prefix6
methods.description: Retrieve the first IPv6 prefix of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_prefix_assignment6
methods.description: Retrieve the first IPv6 prefix assignment of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddrs
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv4 addresses of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddrs6
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv6 addresses and prefix assignments of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddrs_all
methods.description: Retrieve all IP addresses (IPv4 and IPv6) of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_subnets
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv4 subnets of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_subnets6
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv6 subnets and prefix assignments of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_prefixes6
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv6 prefixes of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_prefix_assignments6
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv6 prefix assignments of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_gateway
methods.description: Retrieve the IPv4 gateway of a specified interface, optionally including inactive routes.

methods.name: network_get_gateway6
methods.description: Retrieve the IPv6 gateway of a specified interface, optionally including inactive routes.

methods.name: network_get_dnsserver
methods.description: Retrieve DNS servers for a specified interface, optionally including inactive servers.

methods.name: network_get_dnssearch
methods.description: Retrieve DNS search domains for a specified interface, optionally including inactive domains.

methods.name: network_find_wan
methods.description: Find the interface holding the current IPv4 default route.

methods.name: network_find_wan6
methods.description: Find the interface holding the current IPv6 default route.

methods.name: network_is_up
methods.description: Check if a specified interface is active/up.

methods.name: network_get_protocol
methods.description: Retrieve the protocol type of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_uptime
methods.description: Retrieve the uptime of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_metric
methods.description: Retrieve the metric value of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_device
methods.description: Retrieve the layer 3 device name of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_physdev
methods.description: Retrieve the layer 2 device name of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_defer_device
methods.description: Defer netifd actions on a specified network device.

methods.name: network_ready_device
methods.description: Continue netifd actions on a specified network device.

methods.name: network_flush_cache
methods.description: Clear internal cache to force re-reading network data.
